{{Quote|Marchioness XoXaan, commander of the Black Legions|An extract from the Chronicle of Sorzus Syn, 6900 BBY|<ref name="BOS" />}}
The '''Black Legions''' was an elite military unit of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] renegades of the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. Their leader was the [[Marchioness]] [[XoXaan]]. The Black Legions participated in the [[Battle of Corbos]] in [[6900 BBY]]. [[Sorzus Syn]] mentioned the legions in her [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|titular chronicle]].<ref name="BOS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Black Legions were first mentioned in the resource guide ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="BOS" />
